firepit_lever_findings.lever_a_prompt_pin: Applied at BOTH the base FLUX+LoRA mint prompt and the Gemini structure-lock prompt (explicit 'keep the stone fire-ring exactly as composed; do not redraw it / no concentric rings' clause). Did NOT suppress the artifact at either stage.
firepit_lever_findings.lever_b_lorasScale: Swept 0.70 / 0.65 / 0.60 at the anchor-mint stage (seed 42 held constant). All three anchors show the ring artifact to a visually similar degree -- lorasScale in the 0.6-0.7 band does not materially change its severity.
firepit_lever_findings.lever_c_best_of_n_rejection: Inspected all 3 anchors before spending the Gemini pass; none was clean enough to constitute a true 'reject the deformed ones' win -- selected 0.60 as marginally softest, but this was a weak signal, not a clear pass/fail split.
firepit_lever_findings.root_cause_read: The ring is baked into the base FLUX+ControlNet+LoRA generation (a diffusion radial-falloff tell around the fire light source, consistent with the original smoke-test's hypothesis) and Gemini's STRUCTURE-LOCK requirement then PRESERVES it as 'existing structure' rather than removing it -- the anti-ring instruction added to the Gemini prompt is in direct tension with structure-lock and lost. This is the key new finding this pass: the fix needs to either (a) stop the ring from ever appearing in the anchor (untested lever within scope), or (b) carve an explicit structure-lock EXCEPTION for the ground-texture band so Gemini is authorized to repaint just that region.

verdict: NOT CONVERGED this iteration. Candidate (A) median 6.0 vs incumbent (B) median 7.0 vs disguised real-art control (C) median 9.0 (in-band, valid). Below the >=7.0 target and roughly flat-to-slightly-below the original outdoor-lora smoke test's 6.5 baseline -- neither the firepit-pin prompt clause (lever a) nor the lorasScale 0.6-0.7 sweep (lever b) measurably reduced the concentric-ring artifact; best-of-3 rejection (lever c) found no clean winner because all 3 anchors were similarly affected. Proceeding to iteration 2 with a structure-lock EXCEPTION clause targeting the ground-texture band specifically, since this iteration's evidence shows structure-lock is what is actively preserving the defect through the Gemini stage.
